sequenceReference.note: The separately scoped host-profile package StandardRouter's predecessor anticipated: wraps StandardRouter in the smallest framework-neutral ASGI Core Profile boundary. Not a Python ASGI app, not a server, does not select Uvicorn/Hypercorn/FastAPI.

goal: Add AsgiCoreProfileAdapter: a deterministic kernel-side ASGI-shaped profile adapter around one injected StandardRouter instance. Accepts ordinary { scope, body }, validates+decodes ASGI-style headers (extra scope keys ignored), calls router.handle exactly once, converts the response into two frozen ASGI-profile events. No server, no network listener, no host selection.
nonGoals: no HTTP server of any kind
no host selection of any kind
no Postgres, db or schema change
no CI, package.json or dependency change
no release, deploy, readiness or product-runnable claim
no change to src/adapters, src/application or src/sdk

standardRefs.reason: Router/profile matrix obligation: this package is the ASGI Core Profile boundary around StandardRouter.

ASGI Core Profile boundary itself; negative half of the FastAPI-family drift standard — no ASGI/Uvicorn/Hypercorn/FastAPI/Django/Express/Koa coupling. Host conformance and any FastAPI adapter stay a future, separate decision.
standardRefs.consumer: future host conformance package (not built here)

standardRefs.reason: Mutation chain ActionSpec->PDP->ChangeSet->UoW->CommitReceipt untouched: adapter only decodes headers and reshapes the router response; no mutation code.
Tenant isolation not inspected/enforced: headers pass through unchanged, no tenantId read.
No PDP/PEP decision: router.handle is called unconditionally once the scope is well-formed.

red.note: Before src/delivery/asgi-core-profile.mjs existed, this failed with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND.

requirements: npm run check must be GREEN

rollback.trigger: constructor exactness, header decoding, response event shape, or freeze discipline drifts from this record
rollback.action: revert the 5 files in allowedFiles as one shard
rollback.runtimeDataImpact: none: pure request-events-in/response-events-out, no I/O, no listener

userJourney.before: StandardRouter yolları ve metodları eşleştirip tek bir handler'a yönlendiriyordu, ama bir HTTP sunucusunun (ör. Uvicorn/Hypercorn uyumlu bir host) çağırabileceği, ASGI-şekilli bir sınır yoktu.
userJourney.after: AsgiCoreProfileAdapter sıradan { scope, body } isteğini kabul edip başlıkları çözüyor, StandardRouter'ı tam bir kez çağırıyor ve yanıtı iki donmuş ASGI-profil olayına (http.response.start, http.response.body) çeviriyor. Hâlâ hiçbir sunucu çalışmıyor, hiçbir ağ dinleyicisi açılmıyor — bu paket yalnızca gelecekteki bir host'un çağırabileceği şekli kanıtlıyor.
userJourney.note: Bu paketle hiçbir sunucu, ASGI runtime veya framework çalışır hale gelmiyor.

kalanEngel: hiçbir gerçek Uvicorn/Hypercorn host bu adaptörü henüz çağırmıyor; sunucu bağlama ayrı, kapsamı belirlenecek bir paket.

nextPackage.note: A future, separately scoped package may wire a real Uvicorn/Hypercorn-compatible host process around this profile adapter.
